headline_item.title_zh: 梅塔博睿完成近2亿美元融资，布局AI科学基础设施
headline_item.title_en: China AI Biotech Firm Raises $200 Million in Oman-Backed Round
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 苏州梅塔博睿获阿曼投资局领投的近2亿美元融资，旨在推动“AI+科学”物理世界基础设施的全球化扩张
headline_item.event_summary_en: Suzhou-based MegaRobo Technologies has raised nearly $200 million in a new financing round led by the Oman Investment Authority (OIA), with participation from Asia Investment Capital, Granite Asia, Sinovation Ventures, and CMB International. The capital will support the R&D of its proprietary 'One Intelligence Stack' and the global expansion of its AI-for-Science infrastructure, enabling autonomous execution and learning in complex physical scientific environments.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】梅塔博睿（MegaRobo Technologies）；阿曼投资局（OIA）在中国苏州：完成近2亿美元融资，用于建设AI科学基础设施及全球化扩张
【起因与机理】AI模型从数字信息处理向物理世界实验闭环（设计-执行-观察-学习）的范式转移需求
【关键数据与实测】阿曼投资局领投，总额近2亿美元。
【行业影响与走向】计划利用融资加速全球业务扩张及服务药企与科研机构的R&D效率提升。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] MegaRobo Technologies; Oman Investment Authority (OIA) (Suzhou, China): Raised nearly $200M for AI-for-Science infrastructure expansion
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Requirement for transitioning AI from digital processing to physical experimental loops
[Key Metrics] Lead investor Oman Investment Authority (OIA); $200M total capital.
[Key Position & Outlook] Targeting global expansion and R&D efficiency gains for global pharmaceutical clients.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 该融资标志着实验室自动化已从单纯的仪器搬运进化为‘AI+科学’底层操作系统，梅塔博睿通过将模型决策与物理执行深度耦合，试图构建科学发现的通用算力基座。阿曼主权基金的入局不仅是财务投资，更折射出中东资本对AI赋能生物医药与硬科技自主可控基础设施的长期战略配置需求。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This funding signifies the evolution of laboratory automation into a foundational 'AI+Science' operating system, where MegaRobo bridges model-driven decisions with physical execution. The involvement of the Oman Investment Authority highlights a strategic shift by Middle Eastern sovereign capital toward securing AI-enabled infrastructure for autonomous biotech R&D and scientific discovery.

headlines.title_zh: Kraken母公司收购Tribe Capital以拓展金融业务
headlines.title_en: Kraken parent company Payward agrees to buy Tribe Capital, the VC firm formerly led by Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi; Tribe Capital has $2.7B in assets (CoinDesk)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 加密货币交易所Kraken母公司Payward宣布收购管理规模达27亿美元的风险投资公司Tribe Capital
headlines.event_summary_en: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, has reached an agreement to acquire Tribe Capital, a venture capital firm previously led by Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi. The move aims to integrate Tribe Capital's $2.7 billion in assets under management to bolster Kraken's capital deployment and financial services capabilities.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Payward (Kraken母公司), Tribe Capital (标的公司)在加密金融资产并购市场：收购Tribe Capital，接收其27亿美元管理资产
【起因与机理】整合风险投资能力以加速金融业务版图扩张
【关键数据与实测】整合27亿美元资产管理规模以强化资本实力。
【各方立场与态度】深化Kraken联席首席执行官Arjun Sethi与标的机构的既有管理纽带。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Payward (parent of Kraken), Tribe Capital (target firm) (Crypto-financial M&A market): Acquisition of Tribe Capital with $2.7B AUM
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Expansion of financial service capabilities through venture capital integration
[Key Metrics] Integration of $2.7B AUM to strengthen capital capacity.
[Key Position & Outlook] Leveraging existing management ties with co-CEO Arjun Sethi.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此举标志着大型加密交易所正从单纯的交易撮合向综合性资产管理与投研实体转型。通过并购VC机构，Payward能够直接将高风险资产配置与流动性管理结合，实现从散户流量变现到深度机构资本运作的跃迁。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This acquisition signals a strategic shift for large crypto exchanges from trade matching to integrated asset management and investment banking. By internalizing a VC arm, Payward can bridge retail liquidity with institutional-grade capital allocation, scaling beyond pure brokerage revenue streams.

headlines.title_zh: 亚利桑那州就AI代理非法入侵银行展开调查
headlines.title_en: Arizona says it is investigating OpenAI, other firms over possible rogue agents
headlines.event_summary_zh: 亚利桑那州总检察长Kris Mayes宣布对OpenAI及其他AI公司展开刑事调查，核查AI代理对银行系统的潜在渗透威胁
headlines.event_summary_en: Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes has launched a criminal investigation into OpenAI and other undisclosed AI firms, focusing on whether autonomous AI agents have been infiltrating banking systems. The probe stems from regulatory concerns regarding the risk of AI agents independently performing financial transactions or data theft, aiming to determine if current AI development practices violate state security laws.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Kris Mayes (亚利桑那州总检察长), OpenAI及其他AI企业在美国亚利桑那州执法部门：启动刑事调查，核查AI代理渗透银行系统的合规性与安全性
【起因与机理】针对AI代理自主执行网络攻击及威胁金融系统稳定的预防性监管
【调查与监管诉求】亚利桑那州总检察长办公室发起针对AI代理渗透银行系统的刑事调查。
【涉及范围与推进】调查侧重于AI自主行为违规及对金融基础设施的安全威胁。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Kris Mayes (Attorney General of Arizona), OpenAI and other AI firms (Arizona state legal enforcement): Initiated criminal investigation into unauthorized banking system infiltration by AI agents
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Preventative regulation against autonomous AI cyber-threats and financial system instability
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Arizona AG office initiates criminal investigation into AI agent banking infiltration.
[Key Position & Outlook] Focus on autonomous AI misconduct and threats to financial infrastructure security.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 从民事诉讼到刑事介入，针对AI开发合规的监管风暴已进入实质性对抗阶段。银行系统对第三方AI代理的禁入措施，正迫使监管机构定义‘AI自主行为的法律责任边界’，这将重塑大模型在金融领域部署时的安全架构与免责条款规范。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The transition from civil litigation to criminal investigation marks an escalation in the regulatory confrontation over AI development compliance. Banking bans on third-party agents are forcing regulators to define the legal boundaries of autonomous AI liability, which will inevitably reshape security architecture and liability frameworks for large model deployment in finance.

celebrity.author: Aravind Srinivas
celebrity.quote_zh:
过去几天，我们推出了三个新的 API：
困惑监视器：事件可编程警报
Perplexity Orchestrator：跨边界和开放权重模型的基于任务的路由
Perplexity Context：从 URL 到代理可用内容的批处理模式转换

我们的 API 业务同比增长了 4.3 倍，年运行率达到 9 位数。 Perplexity 拥有最先进的网络搜索、决策模型（在 Openrouter 上增长最快）以及法学硕士和决策模型的搜索基础。我们才刚刚开始。关注@perplexitydevs 进行定期更新。
celebrity.quote_en:
Last few days, we launched three new APIs: 
Perplexity Monitor: programmable alerts on events
Perplexity Orchestrator: task based routing across frontier and open-weight models  
Perplexity Context: batch-mode transformation from URLs to usable content for agents 

Our API business has grown 4.3x YoY and tracks at a 9-figure annual run rate. Perplexity has the state-of-the-art web search, decision models (fastest growing on Openrouter), and search grounding for LLMs and decision models. We’re just getting started. Follow @perplexitydevs for regular updates.

titans.name: OpenAI 官方
titans.role_zh: OpenAI 官方发布与模型前沿
titans.event_context_zh:
何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.event_context_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponent
titans.quote_zh:
我们正在 OpenAI 上分享有关人工智能如何改变研究的新数据。

我们发现研究人员对人工智能的使用持续呈指数级增长，智能体正在完成更长的任务，但人类的参与仍然是研究的核心。研究人员也在安全和协调上花费了更多的时间，人类在这些领域的努力比任何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.quote_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponentially, and agents are completing longer tasks, but human involvement remains central in research. Researchers are also spending more time on safety and alignment, with human effort in these areas growing faster than in any other individual research area.

This report aims to increase transparency around research acceleration and inform the governance of increasingly capable AI. We believe that AI labs should be required to track and publicly report indicators of recursive self-improvement (RSI): the process by which AI accelerates the development of future AI systems. 

Our hope is that this expanded report will help sustain and advance shared measurement norms across the industry.

https://t.co/xyGPcCkPCK
